consolidatedFindings.severityRationale: Permanent loss of pool availability (token pool can never return Migrating->Active; slot must be redeployed). No direct principal theft — real stakers exit at the snapshot. Availability/DoS under C4 Medium. Footgun (Law 3): a non-malicious operator running the documented migration runbook is surprised by a routine dust migration permanently bricking the destination pool.
consolidatedFindings.newVsLedgered: SPLIT / ESCALATION. The missing require(credited>0) guard in depositFor is previously ledgered as submitted-qa, fingerprint eae10d60. The NEW consequence — permanent finalizeAndReset brick — exists only because story-009 added the lifecycle state machine + finalizeAndReset(stakerCount==0). This elevates the QA guard-omission to a Medium availability finding. Recommend re-scoping the eae10d60 ledger entry or opening a linked Medium; severity-classifier to re-weigh.
consolidatedFindings.dedupRationale: CODE-001 and PATTERN-001 are the same root cause (asymmetric missing credited>0 guard) and same detonation path (phantom staker blocks stakerCount==0). Merged into one; CODE-001 carries the more complete analysis (ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy floor-division dust mechanism, preconditions, fix). SLITHER-010 flags the exact unconditional _stakers.add(user) at line 635 and is folded in as corroboration, not a separate finding.
consolidatedFindings.preservedDetails: CODE-001 has the most complete analysis (mechanism, preconditions, fixSuggestion, law3Note). PATTERN-001 contributes the LIFECYCLE-STUCK-STATE framing and missingMitigations list.
consolidatedFindings.humanReviewFlag: CONFLICT — REQUIRES HUMAN ADJUDICATION. The faithfulness scanner (F-01 nonFindings + run summary) asserts this brick CANNOT arise because stake() and depositFor() both require amount>0, so 'no path inserts a zero-amount staker' and stakerCount==0 <=> totalStaked==0. CODE-001/PATTERN-001 rebut this precisely: depositFor's amount>0 check is on the PRE-haircut input, while _stakers.add fires after _routeDeposit haircuts the CREDIT (credited) to 0 via ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy floor division — so a staker with userInfo.amount==0 IS insertable despite amount>0. This is a genuine Tier-2-vs-faithfulness disagreement on a Law-1 security finding. Per Law 1 (recall beats tidiness), the finding is PRESERVED at Medium pending a PoC that confirms a conforming strategy books credited==0 on a realistic dust credit. Do NOT suppress on the faithfulness 'cannot arise' verdict alone.

consolidatedFindings.title: Empty-pool gate relocates the b5218ab2 non-uniform AMM haircut from the migration EXIT side to the depositFor RE-ENTRY side: per-user sequential re-deposits into an AMM-backed new strategy credit identical-principal migrants differently by batch order
consolidatedFindings.severityRationale: Identical-principal migrants receive non-uniform credited principal purely by batch ordering — real, permanent redistribution/value loss among migrants; plus the batched same-block AMM deposits are a deterministic, public, sandwichable sequence (MEV). Value leak with stated external requirement (AMM-backed new strategy + non-trivial price impact) = C4 Medium.
consolidatedFindings.newVsLedgered: NEW root-cause-LOCATION; conceptual REVIVAL of b5218ab2 (submitted Medium, ledger marks CONFIRMED-CLOSED at f5f6039 because migrateOut was deleted). The single-realization design closed the defect on the EXIT side; this run finds the same non-uniform-AMM-haircut re-enter on the depositFor RE-ENTRY side, gated/nudged by story-010. Distinct fingerprint (StableStakerMigrator.migrate/depositFor re-deposit vs old migrateOut exit). KEEP AS ITS OWN FINDING, cross-ref b5218ab2 — recommend a fresh entry, NOT reopening b5218ab2.
consolidatedFindings.dedupRationale: No duplicate; ECON-001 is a standalone economic finding. Kept separate from DEDUP-001 (different root cause: AMM ordering/slippage vs missing guard) and cross-referenced to ledger b5218ab2 per instructions. Note the story-010 gate is the enabling nudge: it forbids the safe ordering (depositFor into idle pool, then setYieldStrategy on non-empty pool), pushing operators to wire the AMM strategy before the migrate batch.
consolidatedFindings.preservedDetails: ECON-001 retained in full (attackScenario, MEV sandwich note, profitability scaling, recommendation options a/b/c).

consolidatedFindings.title: Empty-pool gate makes residual-strategy-principal recovery structurally unreachable IF a strategy ever desyncs principalOf>0 at totalStaked==0 (profile O-2) — refuted as a live finding against the conforming reflax strategies

lines.primary: 247-250 (in-place drain branch, now dead under gate)
secondary: 238 (underwater guard could trip and block setYieldStrategy(token,0))

consolidatedFindings.severityRationale: CODE-003 refutes this as a finding against the real strategies: both ERC4626YieldStrategy and ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy (shared AYieldStrategy base) maintain principalOf <-> totalStaked lockstep EXACTLY on every conforming path (deposit credits +creditedPrincipal, withdraw/relinquishPrincipal decrement the requested/capped amount — the same quantities StableStaker moves). principalOf>totalStaked can only arise from a NON-conforming strategy or a strategy-owner KNOWING action behind StableStaker's back (Law-3 trusted). PATTERN-MR-002 concurs the desync is currently unreachable given the story-007 relinquishPrincipal fix (ledger buffer-desync entry: fixed). Therefore likely OUT OF SCOPE as a non-conforming-strategy trust assumption; Low at most.
consolidatedFindings.newVsLedgered: NEW (consequence of story-010 gate) but refuted at HEAD. Related to ledger 0790a76a (rescueERC20 vs buffer), 69c7666 (buffer FCFS), and story-007 lockstep fix — but distinct (re-wiring wedge, not buffer payout). No new live finding.
consolidatedFindings.dedupRationale: ECON-002 (economic framing), CODE-003 (the refutation), profile O-2, and PATTERN-MR-002 are all the same residual-desync-wedge lead at different confidence. Merged. The code-scanner's refutation (CODE-003) is the authoritative verdict: conforming strategies hold lockstep, so this is a strategy-conformance trust boundary, not a live bug. Preserved per Law-1 recall as a Low/OOS note + invariant-generator candidate rather than dropped.
consolidatedFindings.preservedDetails: CODE-003 conformance proof is load-bearing (kept verbatim in spirit). ECON-002 recommendation retained: add a residual-recovery escape — allow setYieldStrategy(token,0) to skip the underwater guard and drain any residual principalOf when totalStaked==0.
consolidatedFindings.downstreamRouting: Feed PATTERN-MR-002's invariant to invariant-generator (Tier-3): assert principalOf==0 whenever totalStaked==0.

consolidatedFindings.severityRationale: Two windows: (a) revival — a front-running 1-wei staker between finalizeAndReset and setYieldStrategy forces an entire new terminal-migration cycle; (b) first-adoption — intentional story-010 design per CLAUDE.md (Law-2 faithful, not a defect). Mechanism confirmed, but a documented mitigation exists (stake is whenNotPaused; setYieldStrategy/finalizeAndReset are pause-tolerant; the finalizeAndReset natspec + CLAUDE.md prescribe wrapping revival in pause/unpause). Leans 'obvious -> trusted' under Law 3, but the cost asymmetry (1 wei vs a full migration cycle) is surprising enough to keep visible.
